task.title: Record the locator-upgrade request brought inside its L1.8 ceiling on L1
task.objective: At 4a846c41 the production locator-upgrade request meets the 180 s L1.8 ceiling at its own output cap on the real Qwen3.5-0.8B: one block of whole lines within 2800 characters, no Recorder fallback candidates, LOCATOR_ATTEMPT_SCHEMA (the plan schema narrowed to one scope, a 200-character value and 80-character texts) at a 256-token cap. verify:ai-locator-upgrade-live is 4/4 with both jobs accepted, largest 62.2 s of inference and 98.3 s at the cap where it was 74.9 s and 186.4 s, and benchmark:ai-model-0-8b now measures the product's own request, locatorUpgradeAtCap 115321 ms, GO on all 8. Append a note to awkit-djnl.1 giving the fix, the measurement and what stays open (a real model plan never proven on a real page, the pin, the license notice, verify:ai-model-pack, verify:ai-model-live and the live quality gates). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: awkit-djnl.1 stays in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.1 stays in_progress with a note naming the fix commit and the live and benchmark results, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, against the state after `bd update awkit-djnl.1 --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents. The tracker measured 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, so the hardcoded tracker pin did not move. Both narratives restate the measured 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.
